brief: A three-storey cabinet with at least three drawers.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: Stacked three levels high: piece:0,0,0;half-n (level 0), piece:0,0,1;half-n (level 1), piece:0,0,2;half-n (level 2) with snaps (snap:0,0,0;half-n, snap:0,0,1;half-n) locking them. Top closed with cover:0,0,2;half-n;top and sides capped (6 caps). Height 240 mm (3 × 80 mm storey).
Three drawers installed, one per storey: drawer:0#0,0#cut at level 0, drawer:1#0,0#cut at level 1, drawer:2#0,0#cut at level 2. Each sits on cut face of half-n base (socket key s).

finish.summary: Built a vertical three-storey cabinet (3× half-n bases stacked at 0,0 levels 0-2) with three drawers (one per level) and finished with top cover and end caps. Verified meshClash clear.

M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
